newsitem.title: USA: Md. Gov adds $300 mln to six-year transport budget.
newsitem.headline: Md. Gov adds $300 mln to six-year transport budget.

text.p: Maryland Gov. Parris Glendening said Thursday he added $300 million to the state's six-year consolidated transportation spending program.

"This capital program supports our goal of improving public safety, fostering economic growth, and plays a critical role in our ability to attract and retain businesses and jobs," Glendening said in a statement.
The governor said he had added a total of $1 billion to the past three transportation spending plans through increased efficiencies, more federal funds, bond sales and a growing economy.
"I am very proud we have accomplished this without raising the gasoline tax," the governor said.
